documents.title: Reply To Clarification On Significant Increase In The Volume Of Security Across Exchanges In Recent Past Sought By BSE Limited
Clarification sought from DMCC Speciality Chemicals Ltd
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Reply To Clarification On Significant Increase In The Volume Of Security Across Exchanges In Recent Past Sought By NSE Limited.

analysis.summary: DMCC Speciality Chemicals Limited reported its financial performance for Q4 and FY26, highlighting challenges due to the Middle East crisis affecting sulfur availability and pricing, alongside supply disruptions of boron ore from Turkey in the first half of the year. The company experienced higher top-line figures driven by raw material price pass-throughs, which also led to increased working capital requirements and short-term borrowings. Management noted that while the Dahej plant operated normally, the Roha plant faced a temporary slowdown to 60% capacity in March due to raw material availability. The company is actively working on new specialty products in boron and polymers, but refrained from giving explicit quantitative forward-looking guidance due to market volatility. DMCC Speciality Chemicals reported a flat top line of INR 126 crores for Q2 FY26, which is 25% higher year-on-year, while profit before tax stood at INR 8.28 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that Europe continues to struggle, leading to a reduction in the company's speciality chemical business in that region.
demand_outlook.quote: Europe continues to struggle. So, our speciality chemical business has reduced in Europe, but it is improving in other parts of the world.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand for non-boric products is less until the gas situation becomes normal.
demand_outlook.quote: So, what happened is that they stopped consuming whatever raw materials they had, they were selling into the market. And this resulted again in disruption in the market in terms of pricing and oversupply in terms of volume.

demand_outlook.claim: European consumption has decreased and many plants there are shutting down, leading to lower exports.
demand_outlook.quote: exports, particularly to Europe have come down. On the positive side, and that is not because of competition or anything, but it's more because the consumption in Europe has come down. We have not lost business to competition, but because of internal issues within Europe, including their energy policy and things like that, they have reduced their consumption. And in fact, a lot of the plants are shutting down.

demand_outlook.claim: The overall situation has been better than the previous 2 years, except for the European markets where consumption has come down.
demand_outlook.quote: And overall, the situation has been better than the previous 2 years with one major exception being the European markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Export sales, which mostly constitute Specialty Chemicals, took a hit because of EU market conditions.
demand_outlook.quote: So apart from positive changes in the domestic consumption in India and particularly in the boron business where we have had some good growth, the export sales and that constitutes mostly Specialty Chemicals has taken a hit because of the EU market conditions.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has made some headway in Latin American countries and is selling some products into China.
demand_outlook.quote: And we are looking at and we have been active in developing new markets. So we are making some headway in Latin American countries, where we have seen decent growth. And we are also selling some products into China, which we were not doing earlier.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a solar power plant at the end of the quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: We have also commissioned at the end of the quarter a solar power plant.

capex_expansion.claim: Approved capital expenditure for the current year is about INR 10 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: About INR 10 crores is our CAPEX approved for this year and it will be around the same level next year unless we do some other projects.

capex_expansion.claim: All major investments planned have been made, and the company is not envisaging any major capex at this time.
capex_expansion.quote: And all our major investments that we had planned have been made. So we are not envisaging any major CAPEX at this time.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has a plan of about INR 10 crores to INR 15 crores, but nothing major compared to the Dahej expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: We have a plan of about INR 10 crores to INR 15 crores, but nothing major compared to what we have done, the major expansion at Dahej, which happened over the last few years.

capex_expansion.claim: For the boron business, most capex investment has been done and only incremental investment or debottlenecking is planned.
capex_expansion.quote: And our -- most of our CAPEX investment has been done. So what we will do is incremental investment or debottlenecking, that kind of thing. No substantial CAPEX needed.

margins_costs.claim: Interest rates on incremental working capital lines are in the range of 8.75% to 9%.
margins_costs.quote: So, it's about 9%, 8.75% to 9% in that range is the percentage of interest.

margins_costs.claim: Sulfur costs have increased for all consumers and producers of sulfur-based sulfuric acid.
margins_costs.quote: Sulfur costs have gone up, not only for us, but for all consumers of sulfur and producers of sulfur-based sulfuric acid.

margins_costs.claim: For the full year, the company recorded EBITDA margins of about 13.5%.
margins_costs.quote: For the full year, we've had EBITDA margins of about 13.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 of the previous year included a profit on the sale of some investments of about INR 8 crores before tax.
margins_costs.quote: If you compare it to the previous year, it may not seem much of an increase, but I just point out that in the last year and particularly Q4 of last year, we had a profit on the sale of some investments, which was to the tune of about INR 8 crores before tax.

margins_costs.claim: An unusual jump in sulfur price of about 40% impacted margins in the previous quarter and will get reflected in contract pricing in Q1.
margins_costs.quote: What happened in the previous quarter is an unusual jump in the sulfur price, which will get reflected in the contract pricing in Q1 of this financial year.

orders_capacity.claim: The Roha plant ran at approximately 60% capacity for about 15 days due to organizing supply chain logistics.
orders_capacity.quote: And now, it's again back to normal as I mentioned, but for maybe 15 days, we ran at perhaps 60% capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Both the Dahej and Roha manufacturing plants have an installed sulfuric acid capacity of approximately 350 tons per day each.
The commodity business operates between 95% to 100% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: our commodity business, which is sulfuric acid and allied products that operates at more than 90% capacity, I would say, between 95% to 100% capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The specialty chemical business is operating at or slightly below 50% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: The specialty chemical business is at or maybe slightly below 50%.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization in the Specialty Chemicals business is between 50% to 60% on average.
orders_capacity.quote: I would say we are between 50% to 60% in our Specialty Chemicals business in terms of capacity utilization.

orders_capacity.claim: Bulk chemicals plants are practically running at full capacity of 90% or 95%.
orders_capacity.quote: So in the bulk chemicals, we are practically running at full capacity. So even last year, we would have run at 90% or 95% capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: Proceeds from the eventual monetization of the land near Ambernath could be used for capital expenditure or debt reduction.
capital_allocation.quote: Well, we could use it for CAPEX or debt reduction.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital requirements are expected to increase to fund extra needs in the boron business.
capital_allocation.quote: You are exactly right. We will need more working capital. We have already arranged that with our bankers, and they are supporting us.

risks_headwinds.claim: Approximately 50% of global sulfur trade flows through the Gulf of Hormuz, and the Middle East crisis has affected availability and prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Most of the sulfur traded flows through the Gulf of Hormuz. In fact, about 50% of global sulfur trade is through Hormuz. So that has affected availability and therefore the price of the product not only in India but also in other parts of the world including China.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced lost production in the first half of FY26 because of disruptions in the supply of boron ore from their main supplier in Turkey.
risks_headwinds.quote: The first half of the year, we lost a lot of production because of disruption in supply of the boron ore from our main supplier in Turkey.

risks_headwinds.claim: Logistical challenges on the boron business occurred because the main supplier changed its distributor, increasing the lead time to nearly 90 to 100 days.
risks_headwinds.quote: logistical challenges on the boron business. You see there was a change of distributor by the main supplier of the boron raw materials and the previous supplier used to keep stock in India. Now we have to buy ex-Turkey and pay advance before the material is shipped. So, that changes the time for arrival of the vessel by nearly 90 days to 100 days.

risks_headwinds.claim: A potential threat to profitability is the upcoming commissioning of a large copper smelter in Kutch later this year.
risks_headwinds.quote: One of the potential threats to our profitability, as mentioned in the report, is the upcoming commissioning of a large copper smelter in Kutch, and that is expected to happen sometime later this year.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated plans for increasing R&D intensity, with details to be seen in coming quarters.
management_commitments.quote: But we do have some plans for increasing this, and you will see that in the coming quarters.

management_commitments.claim: The boron business is expected to recover and return to normal operations from the second half of the current quarter onwards.
management_commitments.quote: And we look forward to the boron business recovering from the second half of the current quarter onwards.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects products recently launched to get fully accepted in the current year and will develop new products for commercialization next year.
management_commitments.quote: And we expect that the products which we've recently launched will get fully accepted in this current year. And in this current year, we will develop some new products, which we'll take up in the next year for commercialization.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to transition to the new tax regime by next year or the year after.
management_commitments.quote: So both plants are in the same company, and we are currently under the old tax regime, but we expect by next year, we'll go to the new tax regime next year or the year after.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
